notes.title: Affliction - Approved for Early Access
notes.notes:
[b]Affliction[/b],

That's right, [i]Affliction[/i] has been approved for Early Access! Like our previous games, we plan to take full advantage of this time to gather feedback and support to make another amazing title with the help of the community!

[u]The release date for EA is yet to be determined. We'll continue to keep everyone posted and we'll release the first public build when we feel that it is ready.[/u]

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
“We believe that Early Access is a great way to incorporate community input and build community interest.”

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b] ːAflashlightː
“Development time will depend on numerous factors such as community requests and feedback, additions to the game, improvements on the engine, and many more. To give a rough estimate, it will be in development for another several months. We have high hopes and a lot of plans for the project. It's been under development for a long time already and we've made great progress during that time. We will continue to do so in order to build the best possible game that we can, and we'd like to involve the community as much as possible.”

[b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b] ːAmagazineː
“Our goal is to create a great game that will provide hours of entertainment. As with our previous titles, we strive to deliver polished, bug free, and enjoyable gameplay experiences.

The finished build of the game will feature a full storyline, several maps, dozens of enemies, multiple different weapons, new items, more variety in graphics and areas, and an abundance of playtime.

The plan for patches and updates is to release regular updates that will solve issues, fix bugs, and add new features to the game. When we hear of a bug or problem, we'll do everything we can to fix it and deliver a patch as soon as possible. Players are asked to tell us of bugs or issues they're having on the Steam community forums.”

[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b] ːArifleː
“The current version of the game is still in the Alpha phase of development. We're still designing the levels, story, and many of the gameplay features. We have a roadmap which is available for viewing on the community hub to show our current plans, but we would like the players and the community to have a say about what we put into the game.

There are currently a few levels to play, multiple weapons to use, items to find, numerous different enemy types to fight, and a lot of room for further ideas and improvement.

[u]There will be bugs and unfinished features in this version. There will also be instances where starting over from the beginning will be necessary. Please do not purchase the game at this time if you are not willing to deal with issues like listed above.[/u]”

[b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b] ːAbandagesː
“The plan is to have the price of the game directly reflect the amount of content and how polished it is. The price will not change often but it will change when it enters the last stages of development and upon release. During Early Access, the game will be priced much cheaper. This serves as a thank you to early purchasers for pledging their support and our way of putting a fair price on the amount of content received for the money paid.”

[b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b] ːAsyringeː
“We will be focusing on interacting with the community over the Steam community forums. There, we can gather community feedback and discuss ideas to improve the game. We believe that the best games are created when those playing the game have a say about what is added or modified.”

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Affliction - 6/4/17 Status Update
notes.notes:
[b]Affliction[/b],

Hey everyone!

I wanted to stop by and give a status update on the development progress of Affliction.

The first map is nearly completed, it just needs to be populated with items, enemies, etc. It came out looking really well, or so we believe. Over the course of two weeks, the map itself took up over 18 hours to create so far. We put a lot of time and care into the design of our games so we can make as enjoyable of an experience as we possibly can. It may take us longer to finish the game, but we strongly believe it will be worth it in the end.

A large amount of work is already done on the second map, but it is nowhere near completed. We'll have updates on that whenever possible. 

We're planning to have a lot of different maps and scenarios that form a greater story so the mapping will take time.

Weaponry in the game is fairly finished, at the exception of new weapons being added. Currently there are six weapons in the game, but we may be adding a few more.

Enemies in the game already have a lot of variety and there are tons of them, but we're going to continue to explore different ideas and see what fits into the game.

Systems such as the HUD, movement, and interaction are still being fine tuned and will most likely be polished and altered until release.

Sound effects are still something that we'll be working on, probably until release.

Items in the game are also nearly finished. There are several items which can help players on their adventure ranging from bandages to a flashlight. There are also going to be a ton of lore items to help the story move along and give background information as well as useful hints and tips that can help the player in a bind.

The storyline is all thought out and planned but we're still looking into different possibilities about presentation.

The roleplaying version of the game has been revamped and revised several times. We believe it is now in a very fun and enjoyable state. We will release this just as we've released the roleplaying rules for our previous games.

The soundtrack for the game is completed and we think it came out sounding great. We can't wait to see what everyone has to say.

Artwork for the game is done too. We're just working on getting some extras for the storyline.

Anything I've forgotten to mention is likely to be added later or in future status updates. I've requested to put the game into Early Access mode so players can enjoy it early, get a discount for buying it early, and help contribute ideas to making a better game. Like our previous work, we believe the best games are created when the people playing them have a say about how or what the game is. Early buyers will play the game almost as if it were in episodes upon the release of each new update and each major update will feature a new map/mission. That is the plan.

Like always, I'll continue to keep everyone updated.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

I've requested to put the game into Early Access mode so players can enjoy it early, get a discount for buying it early, and help contribute ideas to making a better game. Like our previous work, we believe the best games are created when the people playing them have a say about how or what the game is. Early buyers will play the game almost as if it were in episodes upon the release of each new update and each major update will feature a new map/mission. That is the plan.

Like always, I'll continue to keep everyone updated.

-[b]Corrosion[/b] :CStudios:

notes.title: Affliction - Store Page Description Updated (New Information Released)
notes.notes:
[b]Affliction[/b],

"[i]Set in the fictional Eastern European country of Ghulovka, amidst a terrible civil war, [b]Affliction[/b] allows players to take on the role of Vasya, a patient plagued by nightmares and fractured memories, who awakes inside of a cell in a bizarre research facility where grim human experiments are taking place. With no memory of their reason for being there, players are forced to fight for their survival amidst a hellish catastrophe while frantically seeking answers to discover the truth behind their identity and unveil the mystery surrounding the horrific true purpose of the complex.[/i]

Venture into the [I]Triglav Complex[/I]: an abandoned, cold war era, soviet military research base whose original purpose involved developmental weapons. Now, the derelict compound is operating once again with similar intent. A dreadfully dangerous and highly classified developmental weapon known only as [I]Morana[/I] has been under design for years, but has become too difficult to control and containment has been breached. [b]Affliction[/b] is a survival horror game designed to engage players with a thrilling storyline, surreal lore, sprawling environments, merciless foes, a chilling atmosphere, and an unforgettable gameplay experience. Players must explore, scavenge, and fight in order to survive and live to tell the tale.

Experience the terrifying possibilities of human experimentation and chemical warfare from a first person perspective. The game features many different locations to explore including a disturbing research facility, a dark wilderness, a desolate city, and more. Exploration can be rewarding, but it can also be very unforgiving. Extreme caution is advised with every choice made as there are also many different types of enemies who will bring a grisly demise to any foolish enough to underestimate them. Military death squads tasked to purge, ghastly mutants trying to feed, and renegade anarchists attempting to resist are only some of the many hazards that await in this afflicted story.

[b]Explore[/b]
The dark unknown. ːAflashlightː

[b]Scavenge[/b]
Whatever you can. ːAmagazineː

[b]Fight[/b]
For your life. ːArifleː

[b]Survive[/b]
Against all odds." ːAbandagesː

Will you survive? ːAsyringeː

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u9HV20GsYRw

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

notes.title: Affliction - Community Involvement Invitation & Contest Giveaway
notes.notes:
[b]Affliction[/b],

Would you like to take part in creating a fantastic game? Well, you've come to the right place! Come one, come all and join us in crafting a one of a kind dark-adventure experience! ːAsyringeː

[b]Invite:[/b] ːAbandagesː

So, it's come to our attention that many players want to take part in choosing what goes into the game. We've always welcomed that idea for all of our games, but with this one, we haven't had so many requests because the game is not Early Access. [u]That doesn't mean our community cannot submit requests[/u]. ːAmagazineː

If there is something you'd really like to see in this game, feel free to post your ideas here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/617590/discussions/3/

[b]Contest:[/b] ːAflashlightː

Now, for people who simply want to add a "lore" item to the game like a page from a diary of some dead soul or otherwise, we're giving away 5 keys to those who make something unique. These should not affect the main storyline and should only add other aspects to the game world. Please note that they should not alter major things in the world. An example of this is "North America is completely submerged." They should be small scale writings of events going on in the fictional country of Ghulovka that add some interesting background lore while only being in the game for extra flare. Winners will get a free key to the game and their lore item will be added into the game. ːArifleː

In order to participate, post your lore item ideas in the comments section below surrounded by quotes "". We'll choose the winners on Thursday!

Here is the store page description to give some background information to spark ideas: "Affliction

Based in the fictitious Eastern European country of Ghulovka, amidst a terrible political crisis, Affliction allows players to take on the role of a patient who awakes in a bizarre research facility. With no memory of their reason for being there, players are forced to fight for their survival while frantically seeking answers to discover the truth behind their identity and unveil the mystery surrounding the horrific purpose of the complex.

Affliction is a dark action/adventure game designed to engage players with its surreal lore that features a thrilling storyline where players must fight, scavenge, and use anything at their disposal to its full potential if they hope to escape and live to tell the tale. Players will experience the terrifying possibilities of chemical and biological warfare from a first person perspective. The game features many different locations to explore including a disturbing research facility, a dark wilderness, a desolate city, and more. Exploration can be rewarding, but it can also be very unforgiving. Players are advised to use extreme caution with every choice they make."

notes.title: Affliction - Status Update 1/Q&A
notes.notes:
[b]Affliction[/b],

Hello everyone, just wanted to stop by real quick and give you a status update.

As many of you know, we've been working on mapping, character design, fighting issues with the engine itself, and we've been working on features for the core of the game. 

What we've accomplished so far this week is that we've added a field of view feature that changes when the player runs/sprints. We've seen this in many games and feel that it really gives the illusion of speed and looks pretty awesome. We hope you'll agree. We didn't make the camera shake like crazy or anything drastic or ridiculous like that, that stuff is just annoying. Another thing we've done this week is we've started on the maintenance sector of the facility and so far it looks pretty awesome. Narrow corridors combined with side rooms for storage and utilities make the maintenance sector an interesting place to venture through. For the time being, we've removed crosshairs from the game and the reason for this is because it made the combat extremely easy. Weapons do have a range system but most of the combat in the game will be medium or close range and the crosshair just made it too easy - no skill or strategy required.

To give everyone who's wondering a little more information about the game, I wanted to answer some questions that I recently was asked.

Q: Are there going to be jumpscares?
A: If there are any, they will be VERY few and far between. Probably not, though.

Q: How much is the game going to be?
A: That hasn't been determined yet, but it will reflect how much content there is in the game. Probably around $9.99.

Q: What enemies do you fight in the game?
A: The game will feature several types of enemies that are split among a few different groups. As of right now, there are four groups. These include the civilians (neutral), the facility security (hostile), the military (hostile), and the afflicted (hostile). Civilians will only be encountered once in a great while unless they are dead. The facility security will be encountered early game and they will put up a decent fight and have some good rewards for taking them down. The military will be a real force to be reckoned with. They will have the very best gear and equipment available in the game. They also have a wide variety of character classes and loadouts that will make each encounter dangerous and require a different approach. The afflicted will be the main enemy in the game. Several variations will be in the game for the afflicted. There will be highly sophisticated and mutated creatures, mutated animals, and weaker and less mutated beings that will act much like zombies. These enemies will not be slow in the game, they will be fast and pose an actual threat.

Q: What is the main objective of the game?
A: Although it may not be entirely clear, you're objective is to escape the facility, fight your way through whoever or whatever stands in your way to freedom and solace, and survive. The game is story driven, but it will be more open world than many story driven games.

Q: What do you mean when you say "no hand holding"?
A: The game will force players to actually think for themselves instead of telling them how to do every little thing and where to go and what to do. It won't be completely directionless and will have a tutorial, but it won't help you with a minimap, tons of health items available, tons of ammo or weapons, etc. We're going to try to give you an enjoyable game that let's you play how you want.

Q: When will it be ready?
A: There isn't an exact date. We plan to have it done by the end of 2017 to the middle of 2018. Yes, it'll take awhile, but take in mind it's only one guy (me) working on the main game and contracting out to others for certain things like music, sound effects, very complex code, and artwork.

Q: Can I participate in development?
A: I always encourage the community to get involved in any way they can. The game is being made for the players, why not have ideas from the players?

Q: Can you fight back in this game?
A: Yes!

Q: What weapons will be in the game?
A: Currently, we have the combat knife, the makarov handgun, the agram 2000 sub machine gun, the mp153 baikal shotgun, the ak47 assault rifle, and the dragunov svd sniper rifle. More may come in the future.

Q: What engine are you using?
A: We're using a program that many of you have probably seen called Game Guru. It's designed for small indie teams and we feel that it is a pretty decent engine. This is our first 3D game so we wanted to start off with something that wasn't too terribly complex.

Q: Can I donate?
A: Yes, you can do so here: https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&business=eplasencia.rvn%40gmail.com&lc=US&item_name=Corrosive%20Studios%20LLC&currency_code=USD&bn=PP-DonationsBF%3abtn_donateCC_LG.gif%3aNonHosted

I think that just about wraps everything up. If you have other questions, feel free to post them here!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] ːCStudiosː

A: There isn't an exact date. We plan to have it done by the end of 2017 to the middle of 2018. Yes, it'll take awhile, but take in mind it's only one guy (me) working on the main game and contracting out to others for certain things like music, sound effects, very complex code, and artwork.

Q: Can I participate in development?
A: I always encourage the community to get involved in any way they can. The game is being made for the players, why not have ideas from the players?

Q: Can you fight back in this game?
A: Yes!

Q: What weapons will be in the game?
A: Currently, we have the combat knife, the makarov handgun, the agram 2000 sub machine gun, the mp153 baikal shotgun, the ak47 assault rifle, and the dragunov svd sniper rifle. More may come in the future.

Q: What engine are you using?
A: We're using a program that many of you have probably seen called Game Guru. It's designed for small indie teams and we feel that it is a pretty decent engine. This is our first 3D game so we wanted to start off with something that wasn't too terribly complex.

Q: Can I donate?
A: Yes, you can do so here: https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_donations&business=eplasencia.rvn%40gmail.com&lc=US&item_name=Corrosive%20Studios%20LLC&currency_code=USD&bn=PP-DonationsBF%3abtn_donateCC_LG.gif%3aNonHosted

I think that just about wraps everything up. If you have other questions, feel free to post them here!

-[b]Corrosion[/b] :CStudios:
